game.title: Grand Theft Auto VI
game.scoreNote: critics' average out of 100, checked 22 Nov 2026
game.hook: Thirteen years of waiting, and the reviews say it was worth every one.
article: The biggest game launch in years finally landed on 19 November. GTA VI takes the series back to Vice City, a neon, Miami-style city in the fictional state of Leonida, and follows Jason and Lucia, a pair whose simple job goes wrong and drags them into a crime story that spreads across the whole state.

Critics went all in. It sits at 99 on Metacritic for PS5, level with The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time for the highest score the site has ever recorded, and a long list of outlets gave it a perfect 10.

What you get is a huge open world to drive, rob and wander through: beaches, swamps, highways and a city that feels alive. It's single player, it targets 30 frames per second on every console, and on PS5 Pro it gets sharper image quality and ray-traced shadows.

Who it's for: anyone who likes crime stories, driving around with the radio on, and causing chaos between missions. Who it's not for: kids. This one is strictly for adults, with violence, strong language and mature themes throughout.
game.take: Cancel your weekend plans. Actually, cancel December.
